Commands.Text: /p │ Welcome to my table of doom.
/p │ You can trade me your bank/bet.
/p │ And then just tell me, how much you want to bet.
/p │ This table reacts to specific messages.
/p │     Will call the specific option, if available.
/p │     Make you ready for the next round.
/p │     Get your bank and bet as /tell
/p │     Will update your bet and tells you the change
/p │     Will payout this amount from your bank. You can't payout more than you have ;)
